what: Packages whose committed record is known NOT to reproduce, with the reason. Read before treating a cross-section re-measure as a regression: for these, a different answer is the EXPECTED answer.
whyHandMaintained: Unlike PRE-DESCENT.json this cannot be derived from the logs — it records a comparison between a committed record and a later run that no longer exists. Entries must therefore be retired by hand once the package is re-measured and the new record is the committed one.

entries.remeasuredVerdict: VERIFIED {} on the first arm; DESCEND reported the grant already empty, so N=0 and no descent arms ran
entries.reading: The committed record was never usable evidence. `gate-vacuous` means every file the artifact gate keys on was already present at its final size before any script ran, so the gate passes in every arm including a completely broken one — a green arm for this package carries no evidence either way. The narrower re-measured grant is therefore NOT a demonstrated narrowing and the wider committed one is NOT a demonstrated need; both are unfalsifiable for this package. Do not read the change as a regression, and do not read it as an improvement.
entries.notInvestigated: Which of the several harness changes landed on 2026-08-06 moved the synthesized grant was not isolated — no single-variable run was spent on it, deliberately, because `gate-vacuous` makes the answer unusable regardless.
